name: OmniTool (OmniParser)
description: Computer-use agent that controls a Windows 11 VM using OmniParser screen parsing plus a vision model of your choice.
whatItDoes: Users type a task in a Gradio UI and watch the agent reason and act inside a sandboxed Windows 11 virtual machine. It is intended for testing and researching GUI agents.
howItWorks: Three parts cooperate: a FastAPI server running OmniParser V2 to turn screenshots into structured UI elements, OmniBox (a Windows 11 VM inside Docker), and a Gradio app that runs the agent loop with the selected LLM. Setup steps are in omnitool/readme.md.

requirements.name: KVM
requirements.description: Needed for the VM to run at usable speed (Windows or Linux host)

requirements.name: LLM API key
requirements.description: For OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek or Qwen models

models: OpenAI (4o/o1/o3-mini), DeepSeek R1, Qwen 2.5VL, Anthropic Computer Use
